sentences.en: I need to buy a ticket.
When does the next bus leave?

sentences.en: Can you tell me the way to the airport?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我去机场的路吗？

sentences.en: How long will the journey take?
sentences.zh: 这段旅程要花多长时间？

sentences.en: I want a room with a good view.
sentences.zh: 我想要一个视野好的房间。

sentences.en: Please call a taxi for me.
I enjoy traveling to new places.
